cur-fossil-coalsack-bluff.dateNote: In 1969 Edwin Colbert's team found Lystrosaurus here — an animal already known from Africa and India. It helped prove that the continents were once joined. The Fremouw Formation is about 250 million years old (Early Triassic).
cur-fossil-coalsack-bluff.summary: A fossil find in Antarctica that helped prove the continents drift.

cur-fossil-kirkpatrick.dateNote: William Hammer's team dug a crested meat-eating dinosaur, Cryolophosaurus, out of this mountain in the 1990–91 summer, about 4,000 m up. The Hanson Formation is about 194–188 million years old (Early Jurassic).
cur-fossil-kirkpatrick.summary: Where the first meat-eating dinosaur from Antarctica was dug up, high in the mountains.
